turns.prompt_text: What is the best price for buying ESP32? In small batches to in bulk?
turns.response_html:
The best price for an ESP32 depends significantly on whether you are buying a raw module (requires soldering and external circuitry) or a development board (plug-and-play with USB).

For 2026, prices generally fall into these ranges based on quantity:

Price Breakdown by Batch Size

QuantityRaw Module (ESP32-WROOM)Development Board (DevKit V1/USB-C)
Single Unit (1-5)$3.00 – $4.50$7.00 – $12.00
Small Batch (10-50)$2.50 – $3.50$5.00 – $8.00
Bulk (100+)$1.80 – $2.50$3.50 – $5.50

Recommended Options for Different Batch Sizes

For Small Batches (10–30 units)

Buying in small multi-packs is the most efficient way to lower the cost per unit without managing complex shipping or lead times. Look for "packs" on platforms like Amazon or eBay.

  • ESP32 Type-C Development Board (8-pack): This is a great mid-sized batch option that brings the per-unit cost down to approximately $11.12 for a high-spec Type-C board.
  • Aideepen ESP32 6-Pack: A more affordable bulk-starter set that brings the price down to about $7.38 per board.

For Individual Units & Prototyping

If you just need a few for a specific project, focus on boards with better integrated features like USB-C or built-in battery management.

  • TinyPICO ESP32: While more expensive at $21.95, it is extremely space-efficient and optimized for battery-powered projects.
  • Jacobsparts ESP32 Development Board: A standard, reliable dev board priced at $10.08, perfect for general learning.

For Bulk (100+ units)

If you are scaling a project, you should transition to raw modules. These are significantly cheaper but require a custom PCB.

  • ESP32-WROOM-32D Wireless Module: These modules are currently available for around $4.15 individually, but prices drop toward $2.50 when quoted in bulk from industrial suppliers like Grid Connect or AliExpress.
  • Espressif ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1: For modern smart home projects, this WiFi 6 enabled board is a high-performance choice at $16.51.

Summary of Buying Strategy

  • Lowest Price: Go with the ESP32-C3 or ESP32-C2 variants if your project doesn't require dual cores. These "Lite" versions often cost 20-30% less than the standard ESP32.
  • Best Value: The original ESP32-WROOM-32 remains the most cost-effective "all-rounder" due to the massive volume of production.
  • Bulk Sourcing: For 100+ units, use professional distributors like Mouser or DigiKey if you need guaranteed quality and certifications, or AliExpress if price is the only priority.
